div.i: Supplier payments dated in fiscal 2024 through 2026, split by the Partial column (a payment smaller than its invoice). Every partial payment belongs to an invoice of $1,000 or more, and most of those invoices are between $1,000 and $2,000, so their parts start with the digits 5 to 9 far more often than Benford's Law expects, and with 2 and 3 far less often.
